description: Deactivate a feed without deleting events or resetting editing windows. Confirm the user wants to interrupt subscription access. publication.status reports calendar-file preparation, not subscription access. Check distribution_ready for access at the reported revision; use get_feed_status for current availability. These tools manage Smart Calendars feeds only; they cannot access mailboxes or start source monitoring, scheduled PDF checks or document refreshes. For requests solely for those unsupported actions, explain the limitation without reading feeds or substituting an edit. For unsupported mailbox requests, offer to work with schedule content the user chooses to provide instead. General ICS explanations need no account access. When sharing a feed or filtered_subscription with distribution_ready=true, offer "Open in calendar app" using that object’s HTTPS subscription_open_url (it redirects to webcal), and "Calendar options" using its subscription_options_url for Apple/default, Google, Outlook and copy-link choices. Retain subscription_url as a copyable HTTPS fallback. Prefer these HTTPS handoff links over putting subscription_webcal_url directly in chat, because some clients do not preserve clickable webcal links. If a handoff URL is absent, use the HTTPS subscription_url and dashboard subscription controls instead. Offer "View or edit" using the feed’s manage_url. For a filtered selection use the nested filtered_subscription links, not the unfiltered feed links. Use the returned URLs exactly; never invent or rewrite their host, path or token. Opening a link does not confirm a subscription; the user must confirm in their calendar app. Do not present inactive or unpublished feeds as ready to subscribe.

expected_revision.description: Last read feed revision; prevents overwriting concurrent edits.

feed_id.description: Feed identity returned by a previous feed tool; used to address the selected calendar only.

request_id.description: Generate an opaque key for this save and reuse it unchanged for retries, to prevent duplicate changes. Not a user identifier, chat/session ID, or telemetry. Do not include personal data.

name: deactivate_feed
